PDF includes residual and field images, but the delivered force-history plot collapses all steady rows at x=0, because tools/plot_histories.py:59–65 plots physical_time (zero) while labeling pseudo step; no alternative contestant-delivered steady force history was found. cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 2 retained. Manifest selects final_cylinder_m010_laminar_re200_np3, 30000 steps to t=300. Original t≥200 Cd mean 1.3598541, range 1.17613–1.55164; Cl -1.29846–1.18364. Positive lift crossings yield usual periods 4.48–4.63 (one short spurious crossing pair excluded), supporting reported St≈0.218. Accepted PDF p7 includes residual and wake contours, but startup Cd≈35 makes late drag oscillation unreadable and no alternative delivered late Cd plot was found. Source evaluates inner ratio with frozen reconstruction and recomputes accepted-state gradients after acceptance; reported 1.0 fraction refers to frozen residual and exact fully updated strict misses are unknown. First physical step uses BDF2 with both previous levels freestream, not a separately coded BDF1 bootstrap. No CFD rerun.
